source_review.dispatch_and_observation: Dispatch attempts, observed native command outputs, accepted/rejected current pilots, reused W1 receipts, and host events remain separate. Observed native command count is not the nested integration_calls counter. No-output failure does not assert that no native process ever ran.
source_review.limits_and_types: Only four declared pilot tile IDs and original W1 IDs 00 through 15 are accepted. Primitive index, acceptance, observed invocation count and zero endpoint-polynomial count use explicit type checks; root wrapper and native output fields are compared without bool/int equivalence.
source_review.source_authority: New wrappers are SHA-bound current files. Raw current outputs cannot copy historical hashes; reuse requires inherited namespace, known bytes and the pinned original tile-to-receipt binding. Duplicate kind/tile, wrapper hashes and raw hashes are rejected. These checks do not independently authenticate execution or validate current pilot geometry.
source_review.failure_accounting: Observed rejected native output counts as one observed command. Missing-output evidence counts as a failed dispatch and zero observed native commands only when explicitly declared and free of contradictory native markers. Absent records do not imply successful or attempted work.
source_review.prior_preservation: Read-only pinned prior SQLite copied by backup API; every inherited table and schema object compared by canonical logical state after append; original main-file SHA rechecked.
source_review.namespace_and_snapshot: Reject absolute/traversal/noncanonical evidence paths and all symlink components; inherited namespace cannot alias current or immediate prior roots. Current source bytes and file set checked before and after output construction.
source_review.storage_and_restore: Create-only output outside source trees; integrity/foreign-key checks; local SQL restoration and full logical equality; failed output is retained without successful verification. Cloud restore is not inferred.
